note: The harness copies the attacker input into a fixed buffer and exposes it as the request buffer for parsing.
Because REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS is set in the harness, the first bytes of the input are interpreted as an optional proxy header.
The crafted prefix matches the PROXY v2 signature and dispatches to the v2 parser.
The parser treats the attacker bytes as a structured proxy header and then reads the length field from that structure.
An attacker-controlled 16-bit length expands the number of bytes the parser believes belong to the proxy header.

The only guard compares the claimed record size against the struct size instead of the actual buffered length, so malformed inputs with a crafted length field can still proceed far enough to dereference fields outside the available input span.
The parser then consumes address/port fields from the proxy header, which is the out-of-bounds memory access sink for this candidate.
